summary.text: Bill Allemand is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 58 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a rancher and business owner and faces Democrat Keenan Morgan and Libertarian Joe Porambo in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Bill Allemand was born in Wyoming, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his career experience as a rancher and business owner.
He assumed office on January 2, 2023, succeeding Patrick Sweeney.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Rules and Procedure Committee, the House Appropriations Committee and the corresponding joint committees.
Allemand defeated Peter Boyer in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 50.9% to 49.1%.
